premises.text: Uniform whole-field fertilizer rates waste fertilizer and yield
premises.evidence_span: assigning the rate of the fertilizer, which is the same for the whole field. Now, guess what? This results in huge inefficiency

premises.text: Infrared/satellite imagery produces prescription maps so fertilizer goes only where and when needed
premises.evidence_span: We generate actionable prescription maps for fertilizer application using infrared pictures of the farms

premises.text: Farmers can see crop stress up to 10 days sooner than traditional methods
premises.evidence_span: farmers can see the stress of their crops up to 10 days sooner that they can see it with traditional methods

premises.text: Hyperspectral sensing pinpoints the stressor better than multispectral image competitors
premises.evidence_span: Our hyperspectral sensing is allowing farmers to see the crop stress sooner and, moreover, pinpoint the stressor behind it

premises.text: Workflow: guided sampling, lab calibration, analytics, zoning to variable tractor rates
premises.evidence_span: agronomist is guided where to go sample the crop, and then uses the crop test results from the lab to plug into the platform to calibrate the nitrogen maps

premises.text: Integrates with existing farm management software to tailor prescriptions with farm data
premises.evidence_span: integrated straight into existing farm management software so that we can leverage the years of data that we collected on the farm

premises.text: Annual subscriptions sold to commercial and independent agronomists at per-hectare prices
premises.evidence_span: Annual subscriptions, this is how we sell our product. We provide those to commercial and independent agronomists at the price of $7.5 per hectare and $3 per hectare correspondingly

premises.text: Agronomy firms including the world's largest are channels to market
premises.evidence_span: we have key commercial partners on board, multiple agronomy firms, which are including world's largest, which are our channels to market

value.text: Grow more with less via precise fertilizer application and earlier stress detection

secondary_value.text: Reduce environmental damage from wasted fertilizer
secondary_value.evidence_span: costing our planet $10 billion in environmental damage

causal_links.evidence_span: up to 30% of all fertilizer applied is wasted
fertilizer can go only where it's needed exactly when it's required
which are our channels to market
